mapper.sql: id, username, password, real_name, phone, email, department, dept_id, position, role, status, last_login_time, create_time, update_time, deleted, weekly_permission, monthly_permission, is_admin
mapper.select: SELECT u.id, u.username, u.password, u.real_name, u.phone, u.email, u.department, u.dept_id, u.position, u.role, u.status, u.last_login_time, u.create_time, u.update_time, u.deleted, u.image_url, u.weekly_permission, u.monthly_permission, u.is_admin, d.dept_name FROM sys_user u LEFT JOIN sys_dept d ON u.dept_id = d.id WHERE u.username = #{username} AND u.deleted = 0

SELECT COUNT(1) FROM sys_user WHERE username = #{username} AND deleted = 0
AND id != #{excludeId}

SELECT u.id, u.username, u.password, u.real_name, u.phone, u.email, u.department, u.dept_id, u.position, u.role, u.status, u.last_login_time, u.create_time, u.update_time, u.deleted, u.weekly_permission, u.monthly_permission, u.is_admin, d.dept_name FROM sys_user u LEFT JOIN sys_dept d ON u.dept_id = d.id WHERE u.deleted = 0 ORDER BY u.create_time DESC
